# Talky

> Talky is a native macOS app for hold-to-talk dictation, a searchable scratchpad, and meeting transcription with speaker labels. Speech is transcribed locally on your Mac with Parakeet. Optional API key for punctuation and grammar clean-up. One-time purchase, no subscription.

Talky is an independent app built by Dawid Woźniak and Sature.

## What it does

- Hold Ctrl+Shift to dictate into any text field
- Scratchpad for dictation and meeting history
- Meeting notes with Me, Speaker 1, Speaker 2 labels
- Local Parakeet transcription on your Mac
- Optional bring-your-own-key text improvement (OpenAI, Groq, and similar)
- One-time purchase of $XX (placeholder)
